summary_en: Tender offer price revised from 1,220 to 1,260 yen/share. Minimum acceptance threshold: 4,165,800 shares (~30.2% of S/O ex-treasury). Tender period: 22 June–3 August 2026 (30 business days). Purpose: delisting/going private. Board maintains recommendation. Four shareholders (24.91% of S/O) committed to tender at revised price.
title_en: Amendment to 'Notice Regarding Implementation of MBO and Recommendation to Participate in Tender Offer'
translation_en_brief:
On 19 June 2026, Satudora Holdings' board endorsed a management buyout (MBO) by Terra Corp. and recommended shareholders participate in a tender offer at 1,220 yen/share, with a 30 business-day window (22 June–3 August 2026) and a minimum acceptance threshold of 4,165,800 shares (~30.2% of shares outstanding ex-treasury). The offer targets delisting.

On 10 July 2026, the offeror (Terra) communicated its intention to raise the tender price to 1,260 yen/share, and four shareholders holding 3,433,300 shares (24.91% of S/O) committed to tender all their holdings at the revised price. On 17 July 2026, the board reconfirmed its recommendation, having reviewed the price increase. This notice amends the initial disclosure to reflect the revised offer price and the board's continued endorsement.
